description: Index BILL.ONLINEBOOKING_ID for channel API booking lookups
issue: #24923 — Channel API /complete takes about 25 s under load
author: Dr M H B Ariyaratne
note: ChannelService.findBillFromOnlineBooking() and the EAGER OnlineBooking.bill mapping (mappedBy onlineBooking) both look up bills by ONLINEBOOKING_ID, which had no index, so every channel API /save, /complete, /edit and /cancellation call scanned the whole bill table. This migration adds idx_bill_onlinebooking on that column. It is idempotent: it skips when any index already starts with ONLINEBOOKING_ID. InnoDB builds the secondary index online, so bills can still be saved while it runs; duration scales with the size of the bill table.
